summary:
Plan to humanize and refine discovery call invitation email content, typography, and styling.
Eliminates over-the-top purple gradient banners, garish emoji tags, multiple duplicate buttons, and robotic canned wording in favor of a clean, warm, executive-grade direct conversation format inspired by Stripe/Cal.com emails.
Features conversational, respectful developer copy, a minimalist schedule callout box, and clean interactive meeting links without visual clutter.
